Introduction

Yoon Chaeeun is a South Korean singer, dancer, and rapper under Starting House Entertainment. She made her official debut on May 9, 2023, as a member of the girl group ADYA.

In September 2025, she was announced as a contestant on Mnet's survival show Unpretty Rapstar: HIP POP Princess.
